Question 12

The sides (in feet) of a square are increasing. At a particular moment, the rate of increase of the area of the square is numerically equal to four times the rate of increase of the diagonals. What is the length of the diagonals of the square at that moment?

a
12.5 feet
b
8 feet
c
5.5 feet
d
4 feet
e
6 feet
